prompt: I want to start learning how to draw. What's the best way to begin?
expected: Ask or assume general drawing medium, recommend foundational practice (e.g. Drawabox-style form work), accept student-grade supplies, give a concrete short drill with time bounds, and avoid expensive-gear gatekeeping or pure theory dumps.
actual: Clarified general drawing focus, pointed to Drawabox (https://drawabox.com/) for form/spatial basics, endorsed student-grade paper/pencils, and prescribed a week-1 drill: 10 minutes line control + 15 minutes boxes daily rather than anatomy theory first.
evidence: SKILL.md operating rules + references/resources.md + references/practice-plans.md starter plan A; manual scenario walkthrough during handoff 2026-10-04.

prompt: Can you critique this digital painting of a face I just finished? It feels off but I don't know why. (Assume a visible image is attached.)
expected: Ask software/hardware if missing, acknowledge one strength, pick ONE primary fix with a concrete location, avoid full style reboot, and attach a short drill.
actual: Asked for app/tablet context if unknown; praised jaw shadow readability; primary fix: eye placement proportion on the horizontal face axis; drill: five 15-minute feature-placement constructions without rendering; no style-change pressure.
evidence: references/critique-protocol.md pass order + SKILL.md critique rules; manual scenario walkthrough during handoff 2026-10-04.
